artboards.title: A · needs you filter + hover settle
B · The bell’s card, then Recent

annotations.text:
A · THE LEDGER (leading)
The composer moves to the top and widens to the reading column (860px, the thread composer’s width). Under it, the ⌘Y overlay’s own filter chips and one list of the same rows: asks pinned first as a NEEDS YOU group, then RECENT (George, 2026-09-11: no day buckets). One row anatomy, one derivation. The bell keeps its count for every other screen.
The needs you chip narrows the list to the queue. Settle reveals on hover, as it does in ⌘Y. The project menu and the search sit at the row’s right end, the scope bar order.

B · THE BELL’S CARD
The bell popover becomes a resident card under the composer, Recent below it with search and project only. Tradeoff: two row anatomies on one page, which the sessions shell removed on purpose.

C · TWO COLUMNS
The queue as a right column card, the way the Workbench sits beside a thread. Spends the wide window. Stacks under 1000px. Tradeoff: two columns on a landing, and the queue rows drawn a second way.

D · QUIET
No chips. Asks pinned, then Recent, and ⌘Y for everything else. Least chrome, no status or project narrowing on Home.
